sql: SELECT t1.honor, t2.primary_label, t2.family_label FROM honors_athletes AS t1 INNER JOIN registry AS t2 ON t1.athlete_pointer = t2.athlete_pointer WHERE t2.role = (SELECT r.role FROM honors_athletes AS h INNER JOIN registry AS r ON h.athlete_pointer = r.athlete_pointer GROUP BY r.role ORDER BY COUNT(h.honor) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY t1.season DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.rival_pointer), t1.label, t2.rival_pointer FROM clubs AS t1 INNER JOIN club_duels AS t2 ON t1.season = t2.season AND t1.club_pointer = t2.club_pointer WHERE t2.season = 1915 AND t1.club_pointer = (SELECT club_pointer FROM clubs WHERE season = 1915 ORDER BY victories DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t2.club_pointer, t2.rival_pointer

SELECT t1.standing, t1.season, t1.label FROM clubs AS t1 INNER JOIN tallies AS t2 ON t1.club_pointer = t2.club_pointer AND t1.season = t2.season WHERE t2.shorthanded_helpers >= 7 ORDER BY t2.helpers DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.label FROM club_duels AS d INNER JOIN clubs AS b ON b.season = d.season AND b.club_pointer = d.club_pointer INNER JOIN clubs AS c ON c.season = d.season AND c.club_pointer = d.rival_pointer WHERE b.label = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND d.season = 2000 GROUP BY c.label ORDER BY SUM(b.contests) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t1.penalty_minutes FROM club_cup AS t1 INNER JOIN clubs AS t2 ON t1.club_pointer = t2.club_pointer AND t1.season = t2.season WHERE t2.label = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND t1.season = 1918
SELECT t2.victories FROM club_cup AS t1 INNER JOIN clubs AS t2 ON t1.club_pointer = t2.club_pointer AND t1.season = t2.season WHERE t2.label = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND t1.penalty_minutes = 24

SELECT SUM(CAST(t1.victories AS REAL) / t1.contests) / COUNT(t1.club_pointer) FROM club_cup AS t1 INNER JOIN clubs AS t2 ON t1.club_pointer = t2.club_pointer AND t1.season = t2.season WHERE t2.label = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT r.given_label, r.family_label FROM netminders AS n INNER JOIN registry AS r ON n.athlete_pointer = r.athlete_pointer WHERE n.club_pointer = 'BOS' AND n.season = 1972 AND r.mentor_pointer IS NOT NULL AND r.hall_pointer IS NULL

SELECT n.athlete_pointer FROM netminders AS n INNER JOIN clubs AS c ON n.club_pointer = c.club_pointer AND n.season = c.season WHERE c.label = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY n.athlete_pointer ORDER BY SUM(n.goals_against) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN n.season = 2005 THEN n.contests ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN n.season = 2006 THEN n.contests ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN n.season = 2005 THEN n.contests ELSE 0 END) FROM netminders AS n INNER JOIN registry AS r ON n.athlete_pointer = r.athlete_pointer WHERE r.given_label = 'David' AND r.family_label = 'Aebischer'
SELECT athlete_pointer FROM registry WHERE demise_season IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT r.mentor_pointer FROM registry AS r INNER JOIN honors_mentors AS h ON r.mentor_pointer = h.mentor_pointer WHERE r.athlete_pointer IS NULL AND r.mentor_pointer IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(t1.points), t2.mentor_pointer FROM clubs AS t1 INNER JOIN mentors AS t2 ON t2.club_pointer = t1.club_pointer WHERE t2.club_pointer = 'ANA' GROUP BY t2.mentor_pointer

SELECT T2.athlete_pointer, T2.club_pointer FROM (SELECT athlete_pointer FROM registry WHERE stature IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stature ASC LIMIT 1) AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT athlete_pointer, club_pointer FROM tallies WHERE season BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936) AS T2 ON T1.athlete_pointer = T2.athlete_pointer

SELECT CAST(c.victories AS REAL) / c.contests, t.athlete_pointer FROM clubs AS c INNER JOIN tallies AS t ON t.club_pointer = c.club_pointer AND t.season = c.season WHERE c.club_pointer = 'CAR' AND c.season = 1998 ORDER BY t.goals DESC LIMIT 1
